title: Reset VPN Password
content: To reset your VPN password: visit the VPN portal, enter your employee ID, and follow the emailed link to set a new password.

title: Connect to Corporate WiFi
content: Select 'CorpNet' SSID, use your employee credentials, and accept the certificate prompt.

title: Laptop Won't Boot
content: Try power cycle: hold power 10s, remove battery (if removable), boot with AC only. If still failing, collect serial number and open a ticket.

title: Email Not Syncing on Mobile
content: Ensure device has internet, check account settings, remove and re-add the corporate email account if necessary.

title: Forgot Windows Password
content: Use the corporate password reset portal or contact IT to initiate a password reset with identity verification.

title: Printer Not Responding
content: Check printer power, network connection, and driver status. Restart the print spooler service if needed.

title: VPN Connection Drops
content: Check network stability, try switching networks, and ensure VPN client is up to date.

title: Slow Laptop Performance
content: Close unused apps, check Task Manager for high CPU/memory processes, and run disk cleanup.

title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
content: Install the approved authenticator app and follow the corporate enrollment steps in the security portal.

title: Access Denied to Shared Drive
content: Request access from the file owner or submit a ticket with the folder path and required permission level.

title: Browser Certificate Error
content: Verify system date/time, accept the corporate certificate if prompted, or contact IT for certificate installation.

title: Install Corporate Software
content: Use the company software center to request or install approved applications; admin approval may be required.

title: Bluetooth Not Working
content: Ensure Bluetooth is enabled, remove and re-pair devices, and update Bluetooth drivers.

title: External Monitor Not Detected
content: Check cables, try different ports, and update display drivers; use display settings to detect monitors.

title: Cannot Print to Network Printer
content: Confirm printer is online, check network path, and reinstall the network printer using the correct driver.

title: Email Attachment Too Large
content: Use the corporate file share or cloud storage link instead of attaching large files to email.

title: Password Policy Overview
content: Passwords must meet complexity rules and be changed every 90 days; use the password manager for secure storage.

title: How to Request New Hardware
content: Submit a hardware request ticket with justification, preferred model, and cost center information.

title: Set Up Out of Office Reply
content: In the email client, go to automatic replies and set your out-of-office message and date range.

title: Recover Deleted Files
content: Check the recycle bin and version history in the file share; submit a recovery ticket if needed.

title: Corporate VPN Split Tunneling
content: Split tunneling is disabled by default; contact IT if you require exceptions for specific services.

title: Set Up Email on iPhone
content: Use the corporate email profile or manual IMAP/Exchange settings provided in the mobile setup guide.

title: Windows Update Fails
content: Run Windows Update troubleshooter, ensure disk space, and retry; escalate if errors persist.

title: MacOS VPN Setup
content: Install the corporate VPN client for Mac and follow the configuration steps in the Mac setup guide.

title: How to Share a Calendar
content: Open your calendar, choose share settings, and grant view or edit permissions to colleagues.

title: Reset MFA Device
content: If you lose access to your MFA device, contact IT to reset your MFA enrollment after identity verification.

title: Corporate Single Sign-On (SSO)
content: Use your corporate credentials at the SSO portal to access integrated applications without separate logins.

title: How to Request Admin Rights
content: Provide business justification and manager approval; admin rights are granted temporarily and audited.

title: Troubleshoot Audio Issues
content: Check volume, default device, and drivers; test with headphones to isolate hardware vs software issues.

title: Set Up Remote Desktop
content: Enable remote access on the host, ensure firewall rules allow RDP, and use the corporate remote access client.

title: How to Clear Browser Cache
content: Open browser settings and clear cached images and files; restart the browser after clearing.

title: Corporate VPN Client Update
content: Install the latest VPN client from the software center to resolve compatibility and security issues.

title: How to Request Software License
content: Submit a license request with justification and number of seats required; procurement will process the request.

title: Mobile Hotspot Not Working
content: Verify mobile data is enabled, hotspot settings are correct, and device limits are not exceeded.

title: How to Use the Password Manager
content: Install the corporate password manager extension and follow the onboarding steps to store credentials securely.

title: File Sync Conflicts
content: Resolve conflicts by choosing the correct version and saving; contact IT if many conflicts occur.

title: How to Request a New Email Alias
content: Provide the desired alias and business reason; IT will create the alias and map it to your mailbox.

title: How to Connect to VPN from Home
content: Install the VPN client, ensure internet connectivity, and authenticate with your corporate credentials.

title: How to Report a Security Incident
content: Immediately notify the security team via the incident reporting portal and follow the incident response guidance.

title: How to Change Display Resolution
content: Open display settings and choose the recommended resolution; update drivers if options are missing.

title: How to Request a Guest Account
content: Provide guest details and duration; guest accounts are time-limited and require sponsor approval.

title: How to Use Company VPN Split Tunneling (Exceptions)
content: Submit a request with the service details; exceptions are reviewed by network security.

title: How to Configure Email Forwarding
content: Set up forwarding in email settings; ensure compliance with data handling policies before forwarding externally.

title: How to Request a Software Update
content: Open a ticket with the application name and version; IT will schedule updates based on priority.

title: How to Connect a Docking Station
content: Connect power and data cables, attach monitors, and install any required docking drivers.

title: How to Use Virtual Meetings Securely
content: Use meeting passwords, enable waiting rooms, and avoid sharing sensitive information in public meetings.

title: How to Request Data Access
content: Provide dataset name, business justification, and manager approval; data access is provisioned with least privilege.

title: How to Troubleshoot USB Devices
content: Try different ports, check device manager for errors, and update USB drivers.

title: How to Configure Email Signatures
content: Use the corporate signature template and set it in email client settings for new messages and replies.

title: How to Request a System Reimage
content: Open a ticket with the reason and backup confirmation; IT will schedule a reimage and restore data as needed.
